name: Ofir Marzouk
title: AI Specialist | Software Developer | FDE | Legal and Property Tech
summary: Full-stack developer and Forward Deployed Engineer who builds and ships complete systems from zero to production. I take real operational problems — from legal workflows and real estate management to a variety of business operations — and turn them into working technical solutions, covering database architecture, backend services, AI integrations, frontend interfaces, and deployment. I've designed and deployed production systems that bring together technology, data, and business processes, balancing technical depth with practical, user-facing value. My background spans 10 years of web and software development, 12 years as a licensed lawyer, and extensive experience in fintech and proptech. I work best at the intersection of customer needs and technical implementation, where understanding the problem is as important as building the solution.
